SELECT ?holdingId ?label ?returnsPct ?cost ?currentValue
WHERE {
  ?holding a wm:PortfolioHolding .
  ?holding wm:holdingId ?holdingId .
  OPTIONAL { ?holding rdfs:label ?label . }
  ?holding wm:returnsPct ?returnsPct .
  FILTER(xsd:decimal(?returnsPct) < 0) .
  ?holding wm:cost ?cost .
  FILTER(bound(?cost)) .
  ?holding wm:currentValue ?currentValue .
  FILTER(bound(?currentValue)) .
}

WITH loss_holding AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           COUNT(holding_id) AS loss_making_holding_count
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    WHERE cost IS NOT NULL
      AND current_value IS NOT NULL
      AND current_value < cost
    GROUP BY investor_id
    HAVING COUNT(holding_id) > 0
)
SELECT p.investor_id,
       p.investor_name,
       lh.loss_making_holding_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
INNER JOIN loss_holding lh ON p.investor_id = lh.investor_id
INNER JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 h ON p.investor_id = h.investor_id
INNER JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 g ON p.investor_id = g.investor_id
WHERE p.risk_tolerance = 'Aggressive'
  AND h.liquidity_score < 25
  AND g.shortfall > 0;

WITH loss_holding AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN current_value < cost THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS loss_holding_count
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    WHERE cost IS NOT NULL AND current_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
    HAVING loss_holding_count > 0
)
SELECT p.investor_id,
       p.investor_name
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 AS p
INNER JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 AS h
        ON p.investor_id = h.investor_id
INNER JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001 AS g
        ON p.investor_id = g.investor_id
INNER JOIN loss_holding AS lh
        ON p.investor_id = lh.investor_id
WHERE p.risk_tolerance = 'Conservative'
  AND h.risk_score > 75
  AND g.shortfall > 0;

    WHERE risk_tolerance = 'Aggressive'
),
high_risk AS (
    SELECT investor_id
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
    WHERE risk_score > 75
),
underfunded AS (
    SELECT investor_id
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
    WHERE shortfall > 0
),
loss_holding AS (
    SELECT investor_id

       a.investor_name
FROM aggressive a
INNER JOIN high_risk hr   ON a.investor_id = hr.investor_id
INNER JOIN underfunded uf  ON a.investor_id = uf.investor_id
INNER JOIN loss_holding lh ON a.investor_id = lh.investor_id
GROUP BY a.investor_id, a.investor_name;

Q1.generated_sql:
WITH loss_holding AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           COUNT(*) AS loss_making_holding_count
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    WHERE cost IS NOT NULL
      AND current_value IS NOT NULL
      AND current_value < cost
    GROUP BY investor_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
),
portfolio_health AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           diversification_score
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
    WHERE diversification_score < 25
),
sector_alloc AS (
    SELECT investor_id
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
    WHERE sector = 'Consumer Goods'
      AND allocation_pct > 0
)
SELECT ip.investor_id,
       ip.investor_name
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 AS ip
INNER JOIN portfolio_health AS ph ON ip.investor_id = ph.investor_id
INNER JOIN loss_holding    AS lh ON ip.investor_id = lh.investor_id
INNER JOIN sector_alloc    AS sa ON ip.investor_id = sa.investor_id
WHERE ip.risk_tolerance = 'Conservative';

Q1.generated_sql:
WITH eligible_investors AS (
    SELECT ip.investor_id
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 ip
    INNER JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 ph ON ip.investor_id = ph.investor_id
    INNER JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001 phld ON ip.investor_id = phld.investor_id
    WHERE ph.risk_score > 25
      AND phld.investment_type = 'Real Estate'
      AND ip.investment_goal = 'Growth'
    GROUP BY ip.investor_id
)
SELECT ip.segment AS segment,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ei.investor_id) AS investor_count
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 ip
INNER JOIN eligible_investors ei ON ip.investor_id = ei.investor_id
GROUP BY ip.segment;

           SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001

  avg_net_by_risk AS (
    SELECT p.risk_tolerance,

    GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
  ),
  avg_risk_score_by_risk AS (
    SELECT p.risk_tolerance,
           AVG(ph.risk_score) AS avg_risk_score
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
    LEFT JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001 ph ON p.investor_id = ph.investor_id

Q1.generated_sql:
WITH cash_flow_sum_per_investor AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow_sum
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
holding_sum_per_investor AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(current_value) AS total_holding_value_sum
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
sector_sum_per_investor AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment_sum
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
cash_flow_avg_signed_per_risk AS (
    SELECT p.risk_tolerance,
           AVG(cf.amount) AS avg_signed_cash_flow_amount
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001 cf
    JOIN ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p ON cf.investor_id = p.investor_id
    GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
)
SELECT
    p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
    AVG(cfs.net_cash_flow_sum) AS avg_net_cash_flow,
    cfavg.avg_signed_cash_flow_amount AS avg_signed_cash_flow_amount,
    AVG(hs.total_holding_value_sum) AS avg_total_holding_value,
    AVG(ss.total_sector_investment_sum) AS avg_total_sector_investment
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
LEFT JOIN cash_flow_sum_per_investor cfs   ON p.investor_id = cfs.investor_id
LEFT JOIN holding_sum_per_investor hs      ON p.investor_id = hs.investor_id
LEFT JOIN sector_sum_per_investor ss      ON p.investor_id = ss.investor_id
LEFT JOIN cash_flow_avg_signed_per_risk cfavg ON p.risk_tolerance = cfavg.risk_tolerance
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance;

Q1.generated_sql:
WITH net_cf AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('Deposit','Dividend Reinvestment','Interest Credit','Lump Sum','SIP','Tax Refund')
                        THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS net_cf
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    avg_cf_amt AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               AVG(amount) AS avg_cf_amt
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    total_holding AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(current_value) AS total_holding
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    risk_score AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               AVG(risk_score) AS risk_score
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    )
SELECT
    p.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
    AVG(net_cf.net_cf) AS avg_net_cash_flow,
    AVG(avg_cf_amt.avg_cf_amt) AS avg_cash_flow_amount,
    AVG(total_holding.total_holding) AS avg_total_holding_value,
    AVG(risk_score.risk_score) AS avg_risk_score
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 AS p
LEFT JOIN net_cf ON p.investor_id = net_cf.investor_id
LEFT JOIN avg_cf_amt ON p.investor_id = avg_cf_amt.investor_id
LEFT JOIN total_holding ON p.investor_id = total_holding.investor_id
LEFT JOIN risk_score ON p.investor_id = risk_score.investor_id
GROUP BY p.risk_tolerance
ORDER BY p.risk_tolerance;

WITH cash AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('Deposit','Dividend Reinvestment','Interest Credit','Lump Sum','SIP','Tax Refund')
                        THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS net_cash_flow_raw
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    holding AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(current_value - cost) AS total_holding_gain_raw
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
        WHERE cost IS NOT NULL AND current_value IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    scenario AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(new_allocation_pct - current_allocation_pct) AS total_scenario_shift_raw
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_SCENARIO_REBALANCING_001
        WHERE new_allocation_pct IS NOT NULL AND current_allocation_pct IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    joined AS (
        SELECT p.investor_id,
               c.net_cash_flow_raw,
               h.total_holding_gain_raw,
               s.total_scenario_shift_raw
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 p
        INNER JOIN cash c ON p.investor_id = c.investor_id
        INNER JOIN holding h ON p.investor_id = h.investor_id
        INNER JOIN scenario s ON p.investor_id = s.investor_id
    ),
    stats AS (
        SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow_raw) AS min_cash_flow,
               MAX(net_cash_flow_raw) AS max_cash_flow,
               MIN(total_holding_gain_raw) AS min_holding_gain,
               MAX(total_holding_gain_raw) AS max_holding_gain,
               MIN(total_scenario_shift_raw) AS min_scenario_shift,
               MAX(total_scenario_shift_raw) AS max_scenario_shift
        FROM joined
    ),
    final AS (
        SELECT j.investor_id,
               (j.net_cash_flow_raw - s.min_cash_flow) / NULLIF(s.max_cash_flow - s.min_cash_flow, 0) AS norm_cash_flow,
               (j.total_holding_gain_raw - s.min_holding_gain) / NULLIF(s.max_holding_gain - s.min_holding_gain, 0) AS norm_holding_gain,
               (j.total_scenario_shift_raw - s.min_scenario_shift) / NULLIF(s.max_scenario_shift - s.min_scenario_shift, 0) AS norm_scenario_shift
        FROM joined j CROSS JOIN stats s
    )
SELECT investor_id,
       100.0 * (norm_cash_flow + norm_holding_gain + norm_scenario_shift) / 3.0 AS composite_score
FROM final
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH net_cash_flow AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN type IN ('Deposit','Dividend Reinvestment','Interest Credit','Lump Sum','SIP','Tax Refund')
                    THEN amount ELSE -amount END) AS net_cash_flow
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
cash_flow_amount AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           AVG(amount) AS cash_flow_amount
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
holding_value AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(current_value) AS total_holding_value
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
rebalance_amount AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
risk_score AS (
    SELECT investor_id,
           AVG(risk_score) AS risk_score
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
)
SELECT
    b.risk_tolerance AS risk_tolerance,
    AVG(nc.net_cash_flow) AS avg_net_cash_flow,
    AVG(cf.cash_flow_amount) AS avg_cash_flow_amount,
    AVG(hv.total_holding_value) AS avg_total_holding_value,
    AVG(rb.total_rebalance_amount) AS avg_total_rebalance_amount,
    AVG(rs.risk_score) AS avg_risk_score
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 b
LEFT JOIN net_cash_flow nc ON b.investor_id = nc.investor_id
LEFT JOIN cash_flow_amount cf ON b.investor_id = cf.investor_id
LEFT JOIN holding_value hv ON b.investor_id = hv.investor_id
LEFT JOIN rebalance_amount rb ON b.investor_id = rb.investor_id
LEFT JOIN risk_score rs ON b.investor_id = rs.investor_id
GROUP BY b.risk_tolerance;

Q1.generated_sql:
WITH cash_flow_agg AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    holding_gain_agg AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(current_value - cost) AS total_holding_gain
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
        WHERE cost IS NOT NULL
          AND current_value IS NOT NULL
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    rebalance_agg AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount
        FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    ),
    sector_invest_agg AS (
        SELECT investor_id,
               SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
        FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
        GROUP BY investor_id
    )
SELECT b.investor_id,
       (cf.net_cash_flow + hg.total_holding_gain + ra.total_rebalance_amount + si.total_sector_investment) AS composite_score
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 AS b
INNER JOIN cash_flow_agg cf ON b.investor_id = cf.investor_id
INNER JOIN holding_gain_agg hg ON b.investor_id = hg.investor_id
INNER JOIN rebalance_agg ra ON b.investor_id = ra.investor_id
INNER JOIN sector_invest_agg si ON b.investor_id = si.investor_id
ORDER BY composite_score DESC,
         b.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

The final SELECT computes the composite score as the sum of the four aggregated measures, orders by that score descending (ties broken by investor_id ascending), and returns the top 10 investors.

WITH cash AS (
    SELECT investor_id, SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow
    FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
holding AS (
    SELECT investor_id, SUM(current_value - cost) AS total_holding_gain
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    WHERE cost IS NOT NULL AND current_value IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
sector AS (
    SELECT investor_id, SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
goal AS (
    SELECT investor_id, AVG(shortfall) AS avg_goal_shortfall
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
)
SELECT
    p.investor_id,
    (cash.net_cash_flow + holding.total_holding_gain + sector.total_sector_investment - goal.avg_goal_shortfall) AS composite_score
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 AS p
INNER JOIN cash ON p.investor_id = cash.investor_id
INNER JOIN holding ON p.investor_id = holding.investor_id
INNER JOIN sector ON p.investor_id = sector.investor_id
INNER JOIN goal ON p.investor_id = goal.investor_id
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, p.investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

WITH cash AS (
       SELECT investor_id,
              SUM(amount) AS net_cash_flow
       FROM ATOM_EVENT_CASH_FLOW_001
       GROUP BY investor_id
   ),
   reb AS (
       SELECT investor_id,
              SUM(amount) AS total_rebalance_amount
       FROM ATOM_EVENT_REBALANCING_ACTION_001
       GROUP BY investor_id
   ),
   sector AS (
       SELECT investor_id,
              SUM(total_investment) AS total_sector_investment
       FROM ATOM_ENTITY_SECTOR_ALLOCATION_001
       GROUP BY investor_id
   ),
   risk AS (
       SELECT investor_id,
              AVG(risk_score) AS risk_score
       FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
       GROUP BY investor_id
   ),
   base AS (
       SELECT i.investor_id,
              cash.net_cash_flow,
              reb.total_rebalance_amount,
              sector.total_sector_investment,
              risk.risk_score
       FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 i
       INNER JOIN cash   ON i.investor_id = cash.investor_id
       INNER JOIN reb    ON i.investor_id = reb.investor_id
       INNER JOIN sector ON i.investor_id = sector.investor_id
       INNER JOIN risk   ON i.investor_id = risk.investor_id
   ),
   stats AS (
       SELECT MIN(net_cash_flow)           AS net_cash_flow_min,
              MAX(net_cash_flow)           AS net_cash_flow_max,
              MIN(total_rebalance_amount) AS rebalance_amount_min,
              MAX(total_rebalance_amount) AS rebalance_amount_max,
              MIN(total_sector_investment) AS sector_investment_min,
              MAX(total_sector_investment) AS sector_investment_max,
              MIN(risk_score)             AS risk_score_min,
              MAX(risk_score)             AS risk_score_max
       FROM base
   ),
   final AS (
       SELECT b.investor_id,
              100.0 * (
                  ((b.net_cash_flow - s.net_cash_flow_min) / NULLIF(s.net_cash_flow_max - s.net_cash_flow_min, 0)) +
                  ((b.total_rebalance_amount - s.rebalance_amount_min) / NULLIF(s.rebalance_amount_max - s.rebalance_amount_min, 0)) +
                  ((b.total_sector_investment - s.sector_investment_min) / NULLIF(s.sector_investment_max - s.sector_investment_min, 0)) +
                  ((b.risk_score - s.risk_score_min) / NULLIF(s.risk_score_max - s.risk_score_min, 0))
              ) / 4.0 AS composite_score
       FROM base b
       CROSS JOIN stats s
   )
SELECT investor_id,
       composite_score
FROM final
ORDER BY composite_score DESC, investor_id ASC
LIMIT 10;

    INNER JOIN holding h ON i.investor_id = h.investor_id
    INNER JOIN scenario s ON i.investor_id = s.investor_id

           MAX(total_scenario_shift) AS max_total_scenario_shift,
           MIN(avg_goal_shortfall) AS min_avg_goal_shortfall,
           MAX(avg_goal_shortfall) AS max_avg_goal_shortfall
    FROM per_inv
)
SELECT p.investor_id,
       100.0 * (
           (p.net_cash_flow - m.min_net_cash_flow) / NULLIF(m.max_net_cash_flow - m.min_net_cash_flow, 0) +
           (p.total_holding_gain - m.min_total_holding_gain) / NULLIF(m.max_total_holding_gain - m.min_total_holding_gain, 0) +

Q1.generated_sparql:
PREFIX wm: <https://wealth.example.org/ontology/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>

SELECT ?goalId ?investmentGoal ?progressPct
WHERE {
  ?ig a wm:InvestmentGoal .
  ?ig wm:goalId ?goalId .
  ?ig wm:investmentGoal ?investmentGoal .
  ?ig wm:progressPct ?progressPct .
  FILTER(?progressPct < 30)
}

WITH goal AS (
    SELECT investor_id, AVG(progress_pct) AS avg_goal_progress
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTMENT_GOAL_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
holding AS (
    SELECT investor_id, AVG(dividends) AS avg_holding_dividends
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HOLDING_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
),
health AS (
    SELECT investor_id, AVG(liquidity_score) AS liquidity_score
    FROM ATOM_ENTITY_PORTFOLIO_HEALTH_001
    GROUP BY investor_id
)
SELECT p.investor_id,
       p.investor_name,
       g.avg_goal_progress,
       h.avg_holding_dividends,
       ph.liquidity_score
FROM ATOM_ENTITY_INVESTOR_PROFILE_001 AS p
INNER JOIN goal AS g ON p.investor_id = g.investor_id
INNER JOIN holding AS h ON p.investor_id = h.investor_id
INNER JOIN health AS ph ON p.investor_id = ph.investor_id
WHERE p.risk_tolerance = 'Aggressive'
  AND g.avg_goal_progress > 30
  AND h.avg_holding_dividends < 14000
  AND ph.liquidity_score < 50;

holding_avg AS (
